tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_get_store_config
tools.description: Get the store's settings: name, contact details, currency and VAT rate, SEO data, enabled payment methods, navigation and legal pages, and active campaigns. Good first call. Storefront API: GET /store-config.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_list_categories
tools.description: List the category tree: top-level categories with their nested children (id, name, slug, parentId). Use the slugs with the product tools. Storefront API: GET /categories.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_get_category
tools.description: Get one category by slug (id, name, slug, parentId, children). Storefront API: GET /categories/{slug}.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_latest_products
tools.description: List the newest products in the store, with price, sale price, stock quantity, images and variations. Storefront API: GET /latest-products.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_search_products
tools.description: Browse or search products with pagination. Use q for a full-text search (prefix match, all words must match), slugs to limit to a category, and sort. Returns { name, products, totalCount }. Storefront API: GET /sorted-products.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_count_products
tools.description: Count the products in a category (or in the whole store when slugs is omitted). Returns { count }. Storefront API: GET /products-count.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by slug: description, price and sale price, stock, variations with options and SKU, categories, digital delivery info, rating and review count. Storefront API: GET /product/{slug}.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_get_reviews
tools.description: Get the rating summary (average, count, distribution per star) and the reviews of one product. Storefront API: GET /reviews/{slug}.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_get_page
tools.description: Get one store content page by slug (for example "about", "terms"), with its text and layout blocks. Storefront API: GET /pages/{slug}.

tools.name: putiikkipalvelu_list_shipping_methods
tools.description: List the shipping methods and pickup locations for a postal code. Prices are in cents; the free-shipping threshold applies when cartTotal is given. Storefront API: GET /shipment-methods/{postalCode}.
